text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm on my way back from an outing with
Meisho
Doto when a poster catches my
eye.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh... The shopping district is hosting a
karaoke
competition. I didn't know they
held events like
this.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! B-but, look—it says they're not
taking
entries anymore!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
P-plus, I don't think my singing is
anywhere near
competition level...
Oogh...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wha-whaaaa?! Y-you're embarrassing
me!
choice_data_list: 君の歌なら絶対に大丈夫！
貴方の歌なら絶対に大丈夫！
choice_data_list_en: With your singing, you'll definitely be fine!
With your singing, it'll definitely be amazing!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Although... this could be my chance to
see if my
practicing has paid off.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I g-guess I'll give it a go...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, we decide to give the
competition
a try.

text_block_list.name: Competition Coordinator
text_block_list.text:
Hm, a last-minute entry is going to be
tough. We
can't provide you with a
backing track at this
point.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...U-um, well, I'm a... very flawed person.
I'm not
confident... and I'm indecisive.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...But, many people say good things about my singing. My s-singing!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
That's wh-why, I would like for many
more people
to hear my song... so I'm...
facing my fears and...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! What am I talking about?! I'm
s-sorry for
running my mouth!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah! T-Trainer...
choice_data_list: 自分からもお願いします！
choice_data_list_en: I'd like to ask as well, please!

text_block_list.name: Competition Coordinator
text_block_list.text:
Hm... I hear you two loud and clear! If
you're okay
going a cappella, then we'll
be glad to have you
on.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
R-r-really?! Woooow... Thank you so
much!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It r-really is... I could have never
approached the
stage on my own.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It's all because of Urara, Shakur, and
you,
Trainer. You three have made this a
reality.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm a little s-scared, but... I promise to
give this
my all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Meisho Doto takes to the
stage as the
next singing candidate.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, um... I'm Meisho Doto, and I'll be
sing—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Sputter!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Urk... s-sorry about that. I'm Meisho
Doto, and...
and I'll be s-sing... singing
today!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Hey... will she be all right?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Breathe in... and... out!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The sky above the bay... a shadow on
the pier.
Bearing resemblance to you,
tears strike my
eyes. ♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Love and passion forsake me, I am
alooone!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wow... you can really feel the lyrics!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I only now realize how quiet the
audience has
been—they're all
completely fixated on Meisho
Doto's
voice. Her song must be really
resonating
with them!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Where toooo? You say you will never...

retuuurn! ♪

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Why, miss, that was an incredible
performance!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, oh, ohhh! Wh... what an applause!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, um... Th-thank you for listening!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, um... Th-thank you for listening!
choice_data_list: 素晴らしい歌声だった……！
choice_data_list_en: Victory is in the bag, huh?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Encore! Encore!
choice_data_list: 素晴らしい歌声だった……！
choice_data_list_en: Victory is in the bag, huh?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Not you too, Trainer, and...
everyone else?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you don't mind it, then... I'll
d-do my best
to sing again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto performs for a second time,
gaining
a little pep in her step!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh?! I'm n-nothing special... really!

text_block_list.name: Competition Coordinator
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, your voice is incredible! We'd be
honored
to have you for our next
competition!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eep! Is th-that really okay?! Um... it
would be my
pleasure!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto's singing has earned her a
spot in
the next competition!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You think I've... won?! There's n-no way
when
there are... so many better singers
here!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Well, you've got our vote, missy!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! You all are b-b-being too n-nice
to
someone like—Wha-whaah?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The winning contestants are selected
from the
official entries. However,
thanks to the audience's
support,
Meisho Doto leaves with the special

award!
